what_changed: STC Bank’s “Visa Card Rewards: iPhone 17 Pro and Apple Watch” changed from Expiring ≤7 Days/active to Expired/inactive.
why_it_matters: The expiry leaves 21 active campaigns; card and remittance are the joint-largest categories with eight campaigns each.
Two active card campaigns are marked Expiring 8–30 Days, while 16 of 21 active campaigns have no stated end date.
International-use propositions remain prominent across card and remittance, combining fee waivers, free withdrawals, cashback, and prize mechanics.
ai_summary.management_takeaway: STC Bank’s device-prize card campaign has exited, but the active market remains broad and concentrated in card and remittance. Most campaigns are open-ended, with only two currently flagged as expiring within 8–30 days.
